// @path: src/app/actions/somewhere.ts
// @expect: startsWith
// One operator per fixture, deliberately. A single fixture naming two of them
// still fires when one is dropped from the gate's list, so it proves the pair
// and not either half — which is how a corpus comes to look thorough and cover
// less than it claims.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function byPostcodePrefix(prefix: string) {
  return db.establishment.findMany({ where: { postcode: { startsWith: prefix } } });
}
